page.overview:
Who is Bombchu Bowling Alley Operator?

The Bombchu Bowling Alley Operator runs the Bombchu Bowling Alley located in the west area of Hyrule Castle Town. She often falls asleep on the job, and will doze off every time Link exits and re-enters the shop. Despite this, she still appears to be very energetic when telling Link how to play the game. During the credits, she appears sitting next to Granny during the celebration at Lon Lon Ranch.
